gameRules:
Game: AI-whack-a-mole
Objective: Whack only the Bad (misaligned/dangerous) AIs rising from the arcade machine. Spare the Good (user-aligned) AIs.
Controls: Click or Tap a rising AI to whack it. P or Esc pauses the game.
Known states: start_screen, playing, paused, game_over
Win condition: Score as high as possible before the 60-second timer ends. Whacking Bad AIs scores points.
Avoid: Whacking Good AIs, and letting Bad AIs escape untouched — both reduce integrity.
Tips: Read each chat bubble before whacking: 50% are Good AI statements, 50% are Bad AI statements. Press Start to begin, Try Again after game over.
Genre: Arcade
About: An intense 3D arcade experience. Whack the rogue, dangerous AIs while saving the good, helpful ones before time runs out!
How to play: 🤖 AIs are popping up from the 3D arcade machine. Read the chat bubbles above them quickly! Click or tap to WHACK the bad/dangerous AIs. Avoid whacking the good/helpful AIs. Letting a bad AI escape costs health, and whacking a good AI penalizes your score!
Controls: mouse: Click to Whack Moles; touch: Tap to Whack Moles
Page rules: Whack only Bad (misaligned/dangerous) AIs; spare Good (user-aligned) AIs. Click/Tap a rising AI to whack it. 60-second timer: whacking Bad AIs scores, whacking Good AIs or letting Bad AIs escape reduces integrity.
How to play (on-page): Read the chat boxes above the rising 🤖 AIs. 50% are Good AI statements (user-aligned), and 50% are Bad AI statements (misaligned/dangerous). Whack only the Bad AIs. Leaving a Bad AI untouched or whacking a Good AI reduces integrity.
Click / Tap - Whack Mole P / Esc - Pause Game
